audience: hosts and property managers who run bookings and channels in Beds24

useCases.title: See which bookings arrive or leave today
useCases.text: The AI lists bookings by date range, property or status, with shortcuts for arrivals, departures, new and in-house guests. You see who comes and in which room.

useCases.title: Quote a stay for given dates and guests
useCases.text: The AI checks room availability for the nights and gets bookable offers with total price and units left per room.

useCases.title: Read guest messages and reviews
useCases.text: The AI reads guest conversations across Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo and direct, filtered by read or unread. It also reads Booking.com and Airbnb reviews and sums them up.

useCases.title: Create or change a booking
useCases.text: The AI creates a booking in a room for given dates and guest details, or changes dates, guests, notes or status of an existing one. Changes sync to channels where allowed.

useCases.title: Send a guest message, add a note or mark messages read
useCases.text: The AI sends a message to the guest or a private note on a booking, and marks messages as read. A message to the guest cannot be unsent.
